behavior: Validate a required case-normalized SystemRoot as a nonempty absolute drive-qualified system directory, rejecting unresolved, relative, UNC/device/control/stream/traversal forms.
Require WINDIR, if retained, to name the same normalized system directory.
Derive one canonical SystemDrive from the validated root volume; ignore ambient SystemDrive and its case aliases entirely.
Keep original retained normal-account/PATH variables, case collisions, sensitive-variable drops and owned RESEARCHOS overrides.
Keep Core cwd and relative installed-resource loading unchanged; this does not implement full process cwd isolation.
test_fixture_changes: Two existing positive fixtures now supply the required synthetic public SystemRoot; their optional-home/PATH assertions remain. Four original tests retained, plus30 new actual environment cases.
limits: Pure source/environment/management fixtures do not prove Windows Shell cache expansion or actual fresh GUI behavior.
Root must build a fresh valid bundle and separately scope any actual Desktop/model run. No poisoned bundle modification, cache deletion or manifest-guard relaxation.
Go Harness child environment and standard launcher SystemDrive forwarding are separate paths outside this Core-only slice.
